PRODUCT OVERVIEW

F9 is a full-size electric off-road motorcycle with a permanent-magnet synchronous motor, 72V60Ah battery, ECO and Sport riding modes and IP65 protection.

PERMANENT-MAGNET MOTOR9 kW maximum power and 580 N·m wheel torque.
FULL-SIZE FRAME1440 mm wheelbase and 340 mm ground clearance.
PROFESSIONAL SUSPENSION838 mm front and 509 mm rear shock absorbers.
DUAL DISC BRAKESFront and rear disc brakes with 21/18-inch off-road tires.

DRIVE SYSTEM

9 kW permanent-magnet synchronous motor and electric drive layout.

FRONT FORK

838 mm professional off-road front suspension.

21/18-inch spoked off-road wheel assembly and alloy sprocket.
